criteria.title: Derive and defend the state, ownership and ordering contract for static task pools, stacks and handles.
criteria.task: Specify sixteen slots with one permanent idle and fifteen application slots, disjoint aligned stacks and atomic admission. Design a public slot+generation handle adapter over raw internal IDs, with exhaustion retirement.
criteria.purpose: Raw slot IDs and the capacity8 arithmetic fixture do not establish generation-safe runtime handles.
